bands.label: Higher A2
bands.descriptor: A2 descriptors; all three questions on topic.

bands.label: Lower A2
bands.descriptor: A2 descriptors; two questions on topic.

bands.label: Higher A1
bands.descriptor: A1 descriptors; at least two questions on topic.

bands.label: Lower A1
bands.descriptor: A1 descriptors; one question on topic.

bands.label: Below A1
bands.descriptor: No meaningful language, or all responses completely off-topic (e.g. memorized answers, guessing).

A2.grammar: Some simple grammatical structures are used correctly but basic mistakes systematically occur.
A2.vocabulary: Vocabulary is sufficient to respond to the questions, although inappropriate word choices are noticeable.
A2.pronunciation: Mispronunciations are noticeable and frequently place a strain on the listener.
A2.fluency: There is frequent pausing, false starts, and reformulations, but the meaning is still clear.

A1.grammar: Grammatical structure is limited to words and phrases. Errors in basic patterns and simple grammar structures impede understanding.
A1.vocabulary: Vocabulary is limited to very basic words related to personal information.
A1.pronunciation: Pronunciation is mostly unintelligible except for isolated words.
A1.fluency: Frequent pausing, false starts, and reformulations impede understanding.

above_A2.grammar: Simple grammatical structures are used correctly. Errors occur when attempting complex structures.
above_A2.vocabulary: There is sufficient range and control of vocabulary for the task. Errors occur when expressing complex thoughts.
above_A2.pronunciation: Pronunciation is generally intelligible but mispronunciations put an occasional strain on the listener.
above_A2.fluency: There is some pausing, false starts, and reformulations.

descriptor_sources.A2: Official UZBMB Multilevel speaking rating scale, Questions 1-3, A2 (bands 4 and 3).
descriptor_sources.A1: Official UZBMB Multilevel speaking rating scale, Questions 1-3, A1 (bands 2 and 1).
descriptor_sources.above_A2: Reference only: the official Questions 4-6 B1 text, used only to recognise language above A2. Never band text.
descriptor_sources.below_A1: No text: in Part 1.1 below_A1 means only that there is no meaningful language.
